timing_precision: date-only; exact ordering not independently timestamped
planning_note: Qualitative value-of-information ranks; no numerical DTI forecast or leaderboard projection is claimed.

prior_art_scope.limitation: Prior sibling campaigns are not exhaustively byte-compared. Similar concepts in earlier proposal slates are disclosed. Local uniqueness is not global or organizer-side proof.
prior_art_scope.key_fact: H33-2-B2 and H33-D parent masks overlap substantially; separate construction histories do not establish statistical independence.

hypotheses.name: Positive-only simple-support Dempster fusion of dotted and tip/step-over families
hypotheses.physical_signature: Complementary point-spacing versus structural termination/step-over support; a one-family-only support location is retained with greater residual ignorance rather than treated as known no-fault.
hypotheses.catalogue_gap_rationale: Different candidate-generation rules can nominate a fault-compatible structure that the public fault catalogue omits. However, the B2 construction is catalogue-pruned, so catalogue-proxy scores are potentially leaky and this rationale is not proof of hidden-fault recovery.
hypotheses.difference_from_implemented_repo: A new D-S mass assignment only: m(F)=alpha*s, m(N)=0, m(Theta)=1-alpha*s. Earlier H48/H53/H56 assignments gave some nonzero mass to not-fault when a sparse source did not emit support. H58-A adds no new geological sensor or detector.
hypotheses.expected_dti_improvement: Unknown. Prior D-S family fusions underperformed the stronger parent/H49 public-proxy reference; no positive delta is assumed and no point estimate is defensible.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low; all parent, footprint, proxy and evaluator files are staged.
hypotheses.source_access: Local owner-mirror parents, not organizer-authenticated; source SHA pins are recorded in the builder.
hypotheses.selection: Selected for immediate blocked test because all required inputs are local; it is not a claim of the highest theoretical geological upside.

hypotheses.name: Basement-depth step and gravity-edge concordance
layers: Official competition feature band 13 isostatic gravity
Verified gravity derivatives after metadata review
hypotheses.physical_signature: Coherent, multi-scale lateral step in basement depth co-located with a gravity edge beneath basin cover.
hypotheses.catalogue_gap_rationale: A buried fault may offset basement and density without a mapped surface trace.
hypotheses.difference_from_implemented_repo: H56-B is a written proposal but no such joint basement/gravity candidate was built or scored. Distinct from H57-A K-Th residual by magnetic gradient and from lidar relief detectors.
hypotheses.expected_dti_improvement: Potentially moderate but unquantified; strong lithologic/interpolation confounding.
hypotheses.source_access: Exact official training_features.tif is absent and the DrivenData data tab is login-gated in this environment. A hash-pinned third-party GitHub mirror exists, but is not organizer-authenticated or a license determination. Not currently viable without official-source/terms resolution.

hypotheses.name: Focal-mechanism orientation corridors
hypotheses.physical_signature: Spatially coherent nodal-plane orientations and aligned events, not event-density peaks.
hypotheses.catalogue_gap_rationale: Active blind structures may lack a Quaternary surface-fault trace.
hypotheses.difference_from_implemented_repo: Existing seismicity predictors use density channels; no event-level focal-plane corridor detector is implemented. A related H57-B proposal is unbuilt.
hypotheses.source_access: Official USGS ComCat API; prior repo check recorded bounding-box counts only, not exact footprint coverage or inspected focal-mechanism payloads. Not viable until fields, duplicates, location uncertainty and terms are audited.

hypotheses.name: Cross-channel longitudinal-profile knickpoint lineations
layers: DEM-derived channel network and longitudinal elevation profiles
hypotheses.physical_signature: Repeated slope breaks or lateral deflections across channels with a common orientation.
hypotheses.catalogue_gap_rationale: Fault-related drainage deformation may persist upstream of subdued or alluvium-covered traces.
hypotheses.difference_from_implemented_repo: No full-area channel-profile extraction exists. H52/H53/H54 test scarp relief or trace persistence; earlier H48-4/H57-C channel proposals remain unbuilt.
hypotheses.expected_dti_improvement: Potentially moderate only if profiles are structurally controlled; highly uncertain.
hypotheses.source_access: Official USGS 3DEP is free/publicly documented, but this checkout has only two pilot DEM tiles, not verified full-footprint source coverage. Not viable for the full blocked test until the exact tiles and coverage are obtained and audited.

hypotheses.name: Multi-date Landsat surface-temperature persistence
hypotheses.physical_signature: Repeated dry-season, local temperature residuals organized into persistent linear corridors.
hypotheses.catalogue_gap_rationale: Shallow advective heat may persist over a blind structure without a mapped geomorphic trace.
hypotheses.difference_from_implemented_repo: Distinct from INGENIOUS point probes and static feature-stack channels. Related H50-2 proposal exists but no scene-level candidate has been built or validated.
hypotheses.expected_dti_improvement: Low-to-moderate and unquantified; severe confounders include emissivity, vegetation, cloud, terrain, acquisition timing and lithology.
hypotheses.source_access: Official USGS Landsat Collection 2/STAC pages and a prior broad-bbox catalog query are recorded; no scene payload or usable exact-footprint coverage was verified. Not viable until scenes, QA masks, coverage and reuse terms are checked.

frozen_test.fusion_rule: normalized Dempster; K is analytically zero because neither source assigns m(not-fault)
frozen_test.submission_surface: Bel(F) divided by footprint maximum; relative favorability in [0,1], not probability-calibrated
frozen_test.outside_encoding: finite zeros so every TIFF sample, including outside-footprint cells, lies in [0,1]; this is a local range safeguard, not confirmation that the competition accepts zero outside instead of its documented null/NaN convention
not_mean_checks: Pearson correlation and MAE against binary parent arithmetic mean inside footprint
Pearson correlation and MAE against normalized 300 m kernel-support mean inside footprint
deterministic sampled Spearman and top-37654 rank Jaccard

holdout.folds: four fixed map quadrants; each held-out core plus 300 m footprint-clipped halo; only core truth scored
holdout.metric: distance-weighted Tversky, alpha=0.2, beta=0.8, 300 m triangular kernel
targets: newer derived SGMC fault pixels strictly >300m from a positive catalogue cell
older raw SGMC sensitivity, reported separately
holdout.reference: pinned H49 current same-protocol public-proxy best
holdout.necessary_pass_rule: positive mean paired DTI delta and at least 3 of 4 positive folds against H49 on both primary proxy targets
holdout.weekly_slot: not authorized by a public-proxy pass; do not spend a slot if the candidate fails
